context: A mom helps her young son interpret a school event
purpose: Teach: ギャップ/育ち/不信/浮気/大騒ぎ/おいしかっ/おいしく/怒る

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、今日クラスで、大騒ぎあったよ。
lines.en: Mom, something big happened in class today.
lines.style: Hesitant opening, like he's gathering his thoughts. Quiet, careful tone — testing to see if she'll want to hear it. Slight uncertainty underneath, as if the news still sits uncomfortably with him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あらら、誰かが怒る場面でも?
lines.style: Warm, attentive. She leans in just slightly — not alarmed, but genuinely curious. A mother's practiced ease, inviting him to say more without pushing. Light and open-ended.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ううん、ナナちゃんの好きな子、浮気疑惑がかかってて、不信なんだって。
lines.en: No, but Nana's crush got accused of cheating on someone. She's really upset about it.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery, like he's relaying the facts as a observer. Steady pace — he's noticed this drama, turned it over, but hasn't made it his own worry. A small, clear voice laying out what he saw.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 子供同士の浮気騒ぎ、可愛いギャップね。
lines.en: Cheating drama among kids — there's something almost sweet about it.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself. A knowing smile in the voice. She's catching something both tender and ridiculous about the moment. Warm without being dismissive of what mattered to them.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 給食、ハンバーグ、めちゃおいしかった!
lines.en: Oh, and lunch today — the hamburger was really good!
lines.style: Sudden brightness. The switch is genuine and quick, like something just made him happy. Open, clear vowels. The simple delight of a kid who found something worth savoring.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夜ご飯もおいしく作るから、楽しみにしててね。育ち盛りだもんね。
lines.en: I'll make dinner just as tasty — you've got a lot of growing to do, after all.
lines.style: Warm and steady, almost sing-song ease. There's tenderness in the words but no performance — just a mother stating what she knows. She reaches him at his level: food, care, the simple comfort of being fed well.
